name: filter
description: Automod rule engine: filtered terms (Aho-Corasick), regex rules, invite/link blocking with allowlists, mention-spam and caps limits, with configurable punishment and logging.
short: Automod rule engine with regex patterns, invite blocking, and heat scoring.

configFields.label: Filtered Terms
configFields.description: Comma-separated list of words/phrases to block.

configFields.label: Regex Rules
configFields.description: Comma-separated regular expressions to block (case-insensitive, max 256 chars each). Invalid patterns are skipped; patterns that backtrack catastrophically are rejected when saved.

configFields.label: Block Invites
configFields.description: Delete messages containing Discord server invites.

configFields.label: Allowed Invite Codes
configFields.description: Comma-separated invite codes that are always allowed (e.g. your own server's).

configFields.label: Block Links
configFields.description: Delete messages containing links, except allowlisted domains.

configFields.label: Allowed Link Domains
configFields.description: Comma-separated domains exempt from link blocking (subdomains included), e.g. youtube.com, github.com.

configFields.label: Max Mentions
configFields.description: Maximum user+role mentions per message. 0 disables the rule.

configFields.label: Max Caps %
configFields.description: Delete messages whose letters are more than this % uppercase. 0 disables the rule.

configFields.label: Caps Min Length
configFields.description: Messages shorter than this never trip the caps rule.

configFields.label: Exempt Role IDs
configFields.description: Comma-separated role IDs that bypass all filter rules (members with Manage Messages are always exempt).

configFields.label: Timeout (minutes)
configFields.description: Timeout the author for this many minutes on a filter hit. 0 disables punishment.

configFields.label: Warning Message
configFields.description: Transient warning sent after a deletion. Placeholders: {user}, {reason}. Empty disables the warning.
configFields.default: {user}, your message was removed for containing {reason}.

configFields.label: Log Channel
configFields.description: Channel where filter hits are logged.

configFields.label: Heat System
configFields.description: Accumulate a decaying heat score per member and escalate on spam bursts.

configFields.label: Heat per Message
configFields.description: Heat added for every message. 0 disables the baseline.

configFields.label: Heat per Mention
configFields.description: Heat added per user/role mention in a message.

configFields.label: Heat per Duplicate
configFields.description: Heat added when a message repeats the member's previous one.

configFields.label: Heat per Filter Hit
configFields.description: Heat added when a message trips a hard filter rule.

configFields.label: Heat per Attachment
configFields.description: Heat added per attachment (image/embed-spam signal).

configFields.label: Heat per Emoji
configFields.description: Heat added per custom or unicode emoji in a message.

configFields.label: Heat per Link
configFields.description: Heat added when a message contains a URL (advertisement signal).

configFields.label: Webhook Multiplier
configFields.description: Message/link heat is multiplied by this for webhook-sent messages. 1 disables special treatment.

configFields.label: Heat Decay / min
configFields.description: Heat points bled off per minute.

configFields.label: Escalating Timeouts
configFields.description: Geometrically increase the timeout duration for members who keep re-tripping heat after their previous timeout expires.

configFields.label: Escalation Multiplier
configFields.description: Each repeat timeout after the first multiplies the base duration by this much (e.g. 2 -> 1, 1, 2, 4, 8x the base).

configFields.label: Heat Panic Raider Count
configFields.description: Distinct members who must trip Timeout/Quarantine within the panic window to activate heat panic mode, instantly actioning any flagged member's next message. 0 disables.

configFields.label: Heat Panic Window (seconds)
configFields.description: Window for counting distinct raiders toward heat panic mode.

configFields.label: Mention Flood Threshold
configFields.description: Total non-exempt mentions guild-wide within the window that trigger an automatic server-wide lockdown. 0 disables.

configFields.label: Mention Flood Window (seconds)
configFields.description: Window for counting mentions toward auto-lockdown.

configFields.label: Auto-Lockdown Duration (minutes)
configFields.description: How long the server-wide lockdown lasts before auto-unlocking.

configFields.label: Warn Threshold
configFields.description: Heat at which the member gets a slow-down warning. 0 disables.

configFields.label: Timeout Threshold
configFields.description: Heat at which the member is timed out. 0 disables.

configFields.label: Quarantine Threshold
configFields.description: Heat at which the member is quarantined. 0 disables.

configFields.label: Heat Timeout (minutes)
configFields.description: Timeout duration applied at the timeout threshold.
